groups.name: Lower Bailey West Curtain Wall Walk

parts.name: Continuous wall walk and masonry support

groups.name: Lower Bailey West Curtain Access Stair

parts.name: Access stair treads and masonry support

rationale: Three independently selectable architectural assemblies. The turret includes its entire shaft and five roof sectors; the stair includes treads, support and landing parapets. The remaining battlement runs share one canonical continuous walk/support (045), so they stay one coherent wall-walk asset rather than duplicating or cutting that stable part. Canonical source coverage remains exactly 13 unique nodes.
